I start the message with the main change.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Describe putting the key change first.
Begin takes het bericht as object and met de belangrijkste wijziging names its opening content. The most important change is presented first.
We have read through the text before sending it.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Report a pre-send review.
Hebben nagelezen is perfect of separable nalezen. Voor verzending places the review before sending, without claiming the text has already been sent.
You can read the details in the linked ticket.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Direct the colleague to supporting detail.
Kunt takes bare infinitive lezen. In het gekoppelde ticket locates the details; the sentence directs the reader to existing supporting information.
This update does not replace the agreed check.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Keep the check separate from the written status.
Vervangt agrees with deze update. Niet denies replacement of the agreed check, so the check is still required separately.
The date is mentioned next to each change.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Explain the dates in the overview.
Staat vermeld describes information recorded in writing. Bij elke wijziging locates the associated date beside each change, rather than setting a deadline.
S=Ik|V=schrijf|G=wat de gebruiker nu kan doen.
I write what the user can do now.

Wat introduces an embedded object question. De gebruiker is its singular subject and kan doen is the final modal/infinitive group.
Who is this update intended for?
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Clarify the update's audience.
Voor wie asks the intended recipient. Deze update is the subject of is; bedoeld describes its intended audience, not actual delivery.
I have removed the old information from the draft.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Report removal of outdated draft text.
Heb verwijderd is perfect with no extra ge- on verwijderd. Uit het concept identifies the draft from which the old information was removed.
We must clearly state the new plan.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Request clarity about the revised plan.
Moeten takes bare infinitive benoemen. Duidelijk describes how to state the new plan, not a report that the plan has already been stated.
The last sentence indicates the desired response time.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Locate the response expectation.
Aangeven splits as geeft ... aan. De gewenste reactietijd is what the last sentence specifies; desired response time is not completed response.
G=Als er geen actie nodig is,|V=zet|S=ik|O=dat|L=in het bericht.
If no action is needed, I put that in the message.

Als introduces the no-action condition, ending in is. Main zet ik follows it; dat refers to the fact that no action is needed.
A short update does not have to be unclear.
You are writing a short workplace update to a colleague, making its purpose, status and requested action clear. Explain that concise writing can remain clear.
Hoeft niet te zijn means does not have to be. Onduidelijk is a state adjective; the sentence says concise writing need not be unclear.
May I forward the invitation to my supervisor?

Mag asks permission, not just ability. Doorsturen stays joined after mag; naar mijn begeleider names the supervisor receiving the invitation.
The link is in the calendar appointment.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Locate the call link.
Staat describes written placement of the link in the calendar appointment, rather than a standing object.
I cannot hear the other participant.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Report an audio problem on the call.
Kan takes infinitive horen. Niet denies hearing the other participant; it does not identify whether the fault is their microphone or your speaker.
How much time do we have for this call?
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Ask how long the call can last.
Hoe lang asks the time available. Hebben we is inverted; voor dit gesprek gives the call's purpose, not a deadline before the call.
We have moved the appointment to the morning.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Report a move to the morning in Belgian Dutch.
Hebben verplaatst is perfect. Naar de voormiddag gives the new appointment period, morning in Belgian Dutch.
I will summarise the decisions after the call.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Commit to a post-call summary.
Zal takes joined infinitive samenvatten. Na het gesprek places this promised summary after the call, not before it.
Let us know whether you can participate.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Request confirmation of attendance.
Laat ons weten requests notification to us; it is not laten we for a joint proposal. Even softens the request, and of je kunt deelnemen asks whether attendance is possible.
G=Als het geluid blijft wegvallen,|V=bellen|S=we|PP=via de telefoon.
If the sound keeps dropping out, we call by telephone.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Suggest a fallback for persistent audio trouble.
Als introduces the condition with verb group blijft wegvallen. The main clause follows as bellen we; via de telefoon gives the fallback method.
The external colleague will join in five minutes.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Report the expected joining time.
Aansluiten splits as sluit ... aan. Over vijf minuten means in five minutes; the present describes the expected future joining time.
This meeting is not being recorded.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. State that recording is not taking place.
Wordt opgenomen is present passive, with the meeting receiving the recording action. Niet denies recording; opgenomen is not a separate finite verb.
Do we have everyone in the call?
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Check that all expected participants are present.
Hebben precedes subject we in the yes/no question. Iedereen is the object; the context is all expected participants, not every person everywhere.
S=Ik|V=bevestig|G=dat de afspraak morgen om tien uur doorgaat.
I confirm that the appointment will go ahead tomorrow at ten.
You are arranging or joining a remote workplace call and checking timing, sound and the purpose of the conversation. Confirm tomorrow's call time.
Dat introduces the confirmation and ends in joined doorgaat. Morgen om tien uur gives the scheduled future time, expressed with present doorgaat.
S=De gedeelde map|V=bevat|O=ook de vorige versie.
The shared folder also contains the previous version.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Locate the previous version.
Bevat is singular with de gedeelde map. Ook adds the previous version to the folder's contents without saying it is the current version.
Can you add your comments before Thursday?
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Set a comment deadline.
Kun takes joined infinitive toevoegen. Voor donderdag is the deadline in this scenario, not a purpose phrase.
The attachment is not the final text.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Prevent a draft attachment from being treated as final.
De definitieve tekst is a complement after is. Niet denies that the attached draft is final, without denying that an attachment exists.
Who manages the permissions for this folder?
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Ask who controls folder permissions.
Wie is the question subject of beheert. De rechten op deze map is the object; the question asks ownership of permission management.
We have added the date to the file name.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Report the dated file name.
Hebben aangevuld is perfect of aanvullen. Met de datum names what was added to de bestandsnaam, rather than a new date for the appointment.
This link points to the current overview.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Identify the current reference.
Verwijzen naar names the referenced item. Deze koppeling is singular with verwijst and points to the current overview.
The recipient can only read the document.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. State the recipient's read-only access.
Kan takes bare infinitive lezen. Alleen limits what the recipient can do to reading, so this scenario describes read-only access.
S=Ik|V=vermeld|G=dat de tekst nog wordt nagekeken.
I mention that the text is still being reviewed.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Disclose ongoing review.
Dat introduces the reported status and ends in wordt nagekeken. This is ongoing passive review, not proof of final approval.
IM=Gebruik|O=de versie met het bevestigde versienummer.
Use the version with the confirmed version number.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Direct the colleague to the approved reference.
Gebruik is the imperative stem, with the addressed colleague understood. Met het bevestigde versienummer identifies the version to use.
S=Een nieuwere datum|V=betekent|NEG=niet automatisch|O=een goedgekeurde versie.
A newer date does not automatically mean an approved version.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Distinguish recency from approval.
Niet automatisch denies that a newer date by itself proves approval. Een goedgekeurde versie names what cannot be inferred from that date.
S=De eigenaar|AUX=heeft|O=de toegang voor externe lezers|PT=verwijderd.
The owner has removed access for external readers.

Heeft verwijderd is perfect. De toegang is what was removed; voor externe lezers identifies whose read access was withdrawn.
If the link expires, we request a new one.
You are sharing a workplace document with colleagues, identifying the current version and controlling its intended audience. Explain what to do with an expired link.
The als-clause ends in vervalt. Main vragen we follows it; een nieuwe stands for a new link, with de koppeling understood.
The user has received the explanation.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Confirm delivery of the explanation only.
Heeft ontvangen is perfect. The explanation has been delivered to the user; this alone does not establish understanding or consent.
Which step is still unclear to you?
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Ask which part needs clarification.
Welke stap is the singular question subject of is. Nog onduidelijk asks which part remains unclear specifically to the colleague.
S=De bevestiging|V=betekent|NEG=niet|G=dat de test is geslaagd.
The confirmation does not mean the test succeeded.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Avoid treating receipt as a successful test.
Niet denies the inference from confirmation. Dat de test is geslaagd contains perfect is geslaagd, not evidence supplied by receipt alone.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Check shared understanding through a summary.
Samenvatten splits as vat ... samen. Kort means briefly and describes how the speaker summarises the agreement.
MOD=Kun|S=je|I=bevestigen|G=dat je de bijlage kunt openen?
Can you confirm that you can open the attachment?
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Check attachment access rather than mere delivery.
Kun takes infinitive bevestigen before a following dat-clause. Inside that clause, je is the subject of kunt openen; the question checks usable attachment access.
We have corrected the wrong date.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Report correction of a misunderstanding.
Hebben gecorrigeerd is perfect. De verkeerde datum is what was corrected, not an assertion that every misunderstanding is now resolved.
S=Ik|V=vraag|G=of de instructie voldoende duidelijk is.
I ask whether the instruction is clear enough.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Invite clarification of the instruction.
Of introduces whether and the embedded clause ends in is. Voldoende duidelijk asks about enough clarity, not whether an instruction was merely received.
No answer is not the same as permission.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Avoid assuming consent from silence.
Geen antwoord is the singular subject. Niet hetzelfde als denies equivalence between silence and permission; it does not turn absence of an answer into refusal either.
By agreement, I mean permission for this step.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Define what you mean by agreement.
Met akkoord quotes the term being defined. Fronting that phrase gives bedoel ik; toestemming voor deze stap is the intended meaning, limited to this step.
What do you expect from me after this message?
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Clarify the expected response or action.
Wat is the question object and je the subject after verwacht. The stem ends in t, which remains in inversion; van mij names the person expected to act.
The colleague has correctly summarised the division of tasks.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Report evidence of shared understanding.
Heeft samengevat is perfect of separable samenvatten. Correct describes the accuracy of the task summary, not automatic completion of the tasks.
G=Als de uitleg onduidelijk blijft,|V=plannen|S=we|O=een kort gesprek.
If the explanation remains unclear, we schedule a short call.
You are checking a remote message with a colleague, distinguishing delivery, reading, understanding and agreement. Offer a call if written clarification is insufficient.
The als-clause ends in blijft with adjective onduidelijk. Main plannen we follows it; a short call is conditional on continued lack of clarity.
Can you briefly indicate which option you choose?
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Request a clear option selection.
Kun takes joined infinitive aangeven. Kort means briefly; the embedded which-question ends in kiest with subject je.
S=Ik|V=wacht|PP=op de bevestiging van de nieuwe afspraak.
I am waiting for confirmation of the new appointment.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. State the outstanding confirmation.
Wachten op names the awaited confirmation. Van de nieuwe afspraak specifies which appointment is awaiting confirmation.
What information do you need in order to answer?
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Ask what would enable a response.
Welke informatie is the question object of heb ... nodig. Om te antwoorden gives purpose: the information needed to be able to answer.
You do not need to send the attachment again.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Avoid unnecessary resending.
Hoeft niet te sturen means need not send. Opnieuw means again; this removes a resending requirement without forbidding another send.
S=De eigenaar|AUX=heeft|O=de vraag|PP=naar de juiste collega|PT=doorgestuurd.
The owner has forwarded the question to the right colleague.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Report redirection to the correct recipient.
Heeft doorgestuurd is perfect of doorsturen. Naar de juiste collega names the new recipient; forwarding does not prove that person has answered.
We cannot confirm the appointment without a response.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Explain the response dependency.
Kunnen takes infinitive bevestigen. Zonder reactie states the missing prerequisite; it is not a claim that any reply necessarily confirms the appointment.
IM=Vermeld|O=ook het tijdstip van je controle.
Also mention the time of your check.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Request a timestamp with the reply.
Vermeld is the imperative stem, including its stem-final d. Ook adds the check's timestamp to the information already requested.
S=Ik|V=vraag|G=of de genoemde datum haalbaar is.
I ask whether the stated date is feasible.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Ask about date feasibility.
Of introduces whether and ends in is. Haalbaar describes feasibility of the stated date rather than confirming that it has been agreed.
A short confirmation is sufficient for now.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Set a modest response expectation.
Is takes adjective voldoende. Voorlopig limits the sufficiency of a short confirmation to the present stage.
Can you state only the changed points?
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Request a focused update.
Kun takes bare infinitive benoemen. Alleen de gewijzigde punten limits the requested content to what changed, rather than every unchanged detail.
The response does not have to come today.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Clarify that today is not a deadline.
Hoeft niet te komen removes the requirement for a reply today. It does not mean the reply must arrive later or is forbidden today.
G=Zodra de bevestiging binnen is,|V=werken|S=we|O=de planning|PART=bij.
As soon as the confirmation arrives, we update the plan.
You are requesting a useful written response from a colleague, giving a clear question and a realistic response time. Explain how the response will be used.
Zodra introduces the trigger and ends in is. Main bijwerken splits as werken ... bij, updating the plan as soon as confirmation arrives.
I start a little later today and report that in the team chat.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Notify the team of a later start.
Begin and meld share subject ik across en. Wat later means a little later; dat refers to today's delayed start.
Where do we maintain the shared action list?
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Ask for the shared record location.
Waar asks the location of the shared record. Bijhouden splits as houden ... bij, with we as the people maintaining it.
The user can reach support through the same number.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Keep the support contact route clear.
Kan takes bare infinitive bereiken. De ondersteuning is the service reached and via hetzelfde nummer gives the contact route.
S=Een groen bolletje|V=is|C=geen afspraak voor directe hulp.
A green status dot is not an agreement for immediate help.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Clarify that online presence does not promise instant help.
Geen afspraak is a complement after is. A green online dot does not constitute an agreement to provide immediate assistance.
We have divided telephone duty among three colleagues.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Report the rota allocation.
Hebben verdeeld is perfect. Onder drie collega's identifies the three people sharing telephone duty, rather than three separate phone numbers.
S=Ik|V=laat|O=een bericht|PART=achter|G=als je in overleg bent.
I leave a message if you are in a meeting.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Describe respectful contact during a meeting.
Achterlaten splits as laat ... achter. Als je in overleg bent ends in bent and gives the condition for leaving a message.
Can we coordinate briefly every morning?
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Propose a short daily coordination point.
Kunnen takes joined infinitive afstemmen. Elke ochtend sets the daily frequency and kort the intended brief duration.
S=De agenda|V=toont|G=wanneer ik tijd voor overleg heb.
The calendar shows when I have time for a meeting.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Point to your meeting availability.
Wanneer introduces an embedded when-clause ending in heb. De agenda shows the times when ik has time for overleg, not whether all colleagues are available.
S=We|V=verwachten|O=geen reactie buiten de afgesproken uren.
We do not expect a reply outside the agreed hours.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Set a clear working-hours expectation.
Geen reactie buiten de afgesproken uren removes an expectation of replies outside agreed hours. It does not ban voluntary replies in those hours.
I have reported that I will be absent this afternoon.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Report an afternoon absence in Belgian Dutch.
Heb me afgemeld is perfect of reflexive zich afmelden. Voor de namiddag names the afternoon absence period, not a deadline before noon.
Who keeps the overview current during the late shift?
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Assign upkeep of the shared record.
Wie is the question subject of houdt. Het overzicht is its object and actueel the state to keep it in; tijdens de late dienst limits the duty period.
G=Voordat ik mijn werkdag afsluit,|V=werk|S=ik|O=de status|PART=bij.
Before I end my working day, I update the status.
You are coordinating remote work with colleagues, making availability, ownership and communication channels explicit. Describe your end-of-day update routine.
Voordat introduces the before-clause and ends in joined afsluit. Main bijwerken splits as werk ... bij; the status update precedes ending the workday.
